instruction: Write an XDP program that intercepts incoming ICMP Echo Request (type 8) packets targeting IP 198.51.135.145. Transform each Echo Request directly into an ICMP Echo Reply (type 0) in-place: (1) Swap Ethernet source and destination MAC addresses, (2) Swap IPv4 source and destination addresses, (3) Change ICMP type from 8 to 0, (4) Incrementally adjust the ICMP checksum, and transmit back out the ingress interface with XDP_TX. Pass all non-ICMP and non-matching packets.
requirements: Parse Ethernet, IPv4, and ICMP headers
Match IPv4 destination address equal to 198.51.135.145 (bpf_inet_addr or integer constant)
Verify ICMP type is 8 (Echo Request) and code is 0
Update icmp->type = 0 and update icmp->checksum (add 0x0800 with fold)
Return XDP_TX for translated replies, XDP_PASS for other traffic
Verify all header bounds before access
Entry point SEC("xdp") and GPL license

tests.name: icmp_echo_req_tx
tests.description: Matching ICMP Echo Request must be translated to Reply and return XDP_TX

tests.name: other_ip_icmp_pass
tests.description: ICMP Echo Request to different IP must return XDP_PASS

tests.name: truncated_icmp_pass
tests.description: Truncated ICMP packet must return XDP_PASS safely
